title: Generator substitution induces a normalized augmented Koszul chain map
statement: For a commutative ring A, ideal I, natural r, sequences f,g:Fin r -> A, and A-linear t:A^r->A^r satisfying linearCombination(g) composed with t = linearCombination(f), consider integer extensions of their Koszul complexes [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex, def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology]. For any two augmentations to single(A/I,0) whose degree-zero maps agree with reduction A->A/I under zeroEquiv, there exists a chain map U between the extensions commuting with the augmentations. Its degree -r component, transported through extendXIso, is exteriorPower.map r t. Neither regularity nor invertibility of t is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 48.15.5, finite-free Koszul resolution computation; explicit chain-map/homotopy glue for the local calculation

proof.text: Use the contraction formula of lem-weil-pbc-koszul-differential to prove the degree-n Koszul boundary on a wedge is the alternating sum of complementary wedges with coefficients linearCombination(f)(v_i).

The equality linearCombination(g) composed with t = linearCombination(f) makes contraction commute with exteriorPower.map at every degree. Check on wedges using exteriorPower.linearMap_ext. ChainComplex.ofHom assembles the maps; HomologicalComplex.extendMap extends them to integers.

In degree zero, zeroEquiv_naturality and the two quotient formulas give U followed by epsilon_g = epsilon_f; all other target terms are zero. The top formula is extendMap_f followed by cancellation of extendXIso.

theorem exists_koszul_generator_chain_map
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (r : ℕ) (f g : Fin r → A)
    (t : (Fin r →₀ A) →ₗ[A] (Fin r →₀ A))
    (ht : (Finsupp.linearCombination A g).comp t = Finsupp.linearCombination A f)
    (εf : (koszulComplex A r f).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat ⟶
      (CochainComplex.singleFunctor (ModuleCat A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I)))
    (εg : (koszulComplex A r g).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat ⟶
      (CochainComplex.singleFunctor (ModuleCat A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I)))
    (haugf : ∀ x : ⋀[A]^0 (Fin r →₀ A),
      (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0
        (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).hom
        (εf.f 0 (((koszulComplex A r f).extendXIso
          ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat (i := 0) rfl).inv x)) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk I (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv A (Fin r →₀ A) x))
    (haugg : ∀ x : ⋀[A]^0 (Fin r →₀ A),
      (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0
        (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).hom
        (εg.f 0 (((koszulComplex A r g).extendXIso
          ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat (i := 0) rfl).inv x)) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk I (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv A (Fin r →₀ A) x))
    : ∃ U : (koszulComplex A r f).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat ⟶
        (koszulComplex A r g).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat,
      U ≫ εg = εf ∧
      ((koszulComplex A r f).extendXIso ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat
        (i := r) rfl).inv ≫ U.f (-(r : ℤ)) =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (exteriorPower.map r t) ≫
        ((koszulComplex A r g).extendXIso ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat
          (i := r) rfl).inv
